question: with the read gate off, is the real addressed_read bit-identical to the pre-change read?

criteria.Z1_state_bytes: gate off vs the verbatim pre-change read, same store and same query: the returned fast tensor has identical sha256 and max|delta| = 0 over every one of the 154 queries
criteria.Z2_info_fields: every info field the pre-change read returned has the same value; the only added key is matched=True and it changes no byte
criteria.Z3_post_read_forward: for each written face, a real score_targets forward from the gate-off read state has identical probability bytes and max|delta| = 0 against the legacy read state
criteria.Z4_determinism: the gate-off read is run twice; every returned-state hash is identical across the two passes
criteria.C1_threshold_source: every candidate threshold is derived from the written group only (its minimum top cosine or minimum margin); no negative label enters the value
criteria.C2_separation: per candidate and per group: accept rate, written false-abstain count, and the gap written_floor - class_max; a non-positive gap is reported as 'not separable by this read gate', never repaired by moving the threshold
criteria.E1_enabled_bytes: with the gate at the written floor, each written face either returns bytes identical to the gate-off read (matched) or is counted once as a false abstention
criteria.E2_negative_refusal: per negative class: matched=False share and the size/hash of the payload a consumer would receive if it forced the gate-off answer
criteria.unchanged: no fixture, face, position, class or threshold is retuned after the first reading
